paper.title: Corrupt Bandits for Preserving Local Privacy

unmapped: Learner observes only a corrupted Bernoulli feedback F_t with mean lambda_a = g_a(mu_a), not the reward; regret is on the unobserved rewards
Per-arm mean-corruption functions g_a are known to the learner (continuous; strictly monotonic for upper bounds)
settings.definition_quote: A (stochastic) corrupt bandit problem is formally characterized by a set of arms A= {1, ..., K} on which are indexed a list of unknown sub-Gaussian reward distributions, a list of unknown sub-Gaussian feedback distributions, and a list of known mean-corruption functions {g_a}... g_a(mu_a)=lambda_a

settings.name_in_paper: Bernoulli corrupt bandit with epsilon-locally differentially private feedback corruption scheme
unmapped: Feedback is the reward passed through randomized response with p00=p11=e^eps/(1+e^eps), giving local (not global) differential privacy; learner knows the corruption matrix
settings.definition_quote: A bandit feedback corruption scheme g is epsilon-locally differentially private for epsilon >= 0 if for all reward sequences ... P[g(R) in S] <= e^eps P[g(R') in S].

symbols.D_i: Bernoulli KL d(lambda_i, g_i(mu_1)) between arm i's mean feedback and the image of the optimal mean reward under g_i

source.label: thm:LB
source.quote: Given continuous corruption functions $\{g_a\}_{a \in A}$, any uniformly efficient algorithm for a Bernoulli corrupt bandit problem satisfies, $$\liminf_{T\rightarrow \infty}\frac{\cRegret_T}{\log(T)} \geq \sum_{a = 2}^{K} \frac{\Delta_a}{d\left(\lambda_a,g_a(\mu_1)\right)}.$$

results.notes: Uniformly efficient: Regret = o(T^alpha) for all alpha in (0,1) on every instance.

conditions: corruption functions strictly monotonic and continuous

source.label: UB_KLUCB_Theorem
source.quote: \KLUCBCF \ using  $f(t) \defined \log(t)+3\log(\log(t))$ on a $K$-armed Bernoulli corrupt bandit with strictly monotonic and continuous corruption functions $\{g_a\}_{a \in A}$ satisfies at time $T$, \Regret_T \leq \sum_{a = 2}^{K}\frac{\Delta_a \log (T) }{d\left(\lambda_a,g_a(\mu_1)\right)}  + O(\sqrt{\log(T)}).

results.notes: The leading term has exact constant 1; only the second-order sqrt(log T) term is in O(); notation O used because expression cannot hold O inside. Asymptotically matches Theorem 1. Explicit finite-time bound in appendix proof. Algorithm lists T as parameter but index depends only on t.

symbols.Gamma_i: lambda_i - g_i(mu_1), feedback-mean gap of arm i

conditions: corruption functions strictly monotonic and continuous

source.label: UB_UCB_Theorem
source.quote: With $f(t) \defined \log(t)+3\log(\log(t))$, the regret of \textsc{UCB-CF} at time $T$ on a $K$-armed Bernoulli corrupt bandit with strictly monotonic and continuous corruption functions $\{g_a\}_{a \in A}$ is in $O\Big( \sum_{a = 2}^{K}\frac{ \Delta_a \log(T)}{ (\lambda_a - g_a(\mu_1))^2 } \Big)$.

symbols.C_psi: constant depending on psi, the means and the corruption functions

conditions: corruption functions strictly monotonic and continuous

source.label: UB_TSCF_Theorem
source.quote: When \TSCF \ is run on a $K$-armed Bernoulli corrupt bandit with strictly monotonic and continuous corruption functions $\{g_a\}_{a \in A}$, for all $\psi >0$, there exists a constant $C_\psi \defined C(\psi,\{\mu_a\}_{a \in A},\{g_a\}_{a \in A})$ such that at time $T$, \[\cRegret_T \leq (1+\psi)\sum_{a = 2}^K\frac{\Delta_a\log(T)}{d(\lambda_a,g_a(\mu_1))} + C_\psi.\]

results.notes: psi mapped to eps_alg. Uniform Beta(1,1) priors on feedback means.

symbols.p_00_i: randomized response probability P(feedback 0 | reward 0) for arm i
symbols.p_11_i: randomized response probability P(feedback 1 | reward 1) for arm i

conditions: corruption by randomized response with matrices M_a

source.label: UB_corollary
source.quote: The regret of \KLUCBCF \ and \TSCF \ for a $K$-armed Bernoulli MAB problem with randomized response using corruption matrices $\{\mathbb{M}\}_{a \in A}$ at time $T$ is $$ \sum_{a = 2}^{K}\frac{2\log(T)}{ \Delta_a (p_{00}(a) + p_{11}(a) -1)^2 } + O(\sqrt{\log{(T)}} ).$$

results.notes: Stated 'is' but intended as upper bound (derived via Pinsker). Leading constant 2 recorded as printed (Pinsker would give 1/2). Only the sqrt(log T) term is O().

symbols.p_00_i: randomized response probability P(feedback 0 | reward 0) for arm i
symbols.p_11_i: randomized response probability P(feedback 1 | reward 1) for arm i

conditions: corruption by randomized response with matrices M_a

source.label: UB_corollary
source.quote: The regret of \KLUCBCF \ and \TSCF \ for a $K$-armed Bernoulli MAB problem with randomized response using corruption matrices $\{\mathbb{M}\}_{a \in A}$ at time $T$ is $$ \sum_{a = 2}^{K}\frac{2\log(T)}{ \Delta_a (p_{00}(a) + p_{11}(a) -1)^2 } + O(\sqrt{\log{(T)}} ).$$

results.notes: For TS-CF this does not follow cleanly from Theorem 3 (which has a (1+psi) factor and constant); recorded as printed.

conditions: corruption via randomized response with p00=p11=e^eps/(1+e^eps)

source.label: DPUB_corollary
source.quote: The regret of \KLUCBCF \ or \TSCF \ at time $T$ with $\epsilon$-locally differentially private bandit feedback corruption scheme is $$ \cRegret_T \leq \sum_{a = 2}^{K}\frac{2\log(T)}{ \Delta_a \big( \frac{e^\epsilon - 1}{e^\epsilon + 1}\big)^2} + O(\sqrt{\log{(T)}} ).$$

results.notes: Only the sqrt(log T) term is O(); leading term has explicit constant 2.

conditions: corruption via randomized response with p00=p11=e^eps/(1+e^eps)

source.label: DPUB_corollary
source.quote: The regret of \KLUCBCF \ or \TSCF \ at time $T$ with $\epsilon$-locally differentially private bandit feedback corruption scheme is $$ \cRegret_T \leq \sum_{a = 2}^{K}\frac{2\log(T)}{ \Delta_a \big( \frac{e^\epsilon - 1}{e^\epsilon + 1}\big)^2} + O(\sqrt{\log{(T)}} ).$$

results.notes: For TS-CF the sqrt(log T) second-order term does not follow cleanly from Theorem 3; recorded as printed.
